fields.statement: Verified at a8b6ed9ca. The -run pattern covers 208 Test funcs from the daemon_/run_/ship_/watchdog_/health_/usage_/feed_ files without newSessionFixture (none of the touched files call it). go test -p 2 -trimpath -count=1 -shuffle=on (77.8s) and -shuffle=424242 (76.9s): both ok. -race split into four sequential runs by prefix, each file's serial and parallel tests together: daemon_ 55s, run_ 26s, ship_ 15s, watchdog_|health_|usage_|feed_ 212s. The diff removes no lines and adds no funcs, so nothing was skipped, deleted or merged. rhiza ship generate: exit 0, 0 files changed. rhiza render: no diff beyond this verifier's own actor. No non-test code changed. 159 tests are parallel and 49 serial, and each serial test has a // Serial: comment. Each reason checks out: it swaps daemonReexec/daemonTicker/webFactory/pollGitTimeout/profileWaitEvery/sweepLeftoversWork/feedTicker/channelUpdate*/prePushCheck/runClock (useClock), sets the fake agents' resumeTranscript/holdFakeRecords/holdFakeLive/usageFakeReset/limitLaunches, or calls t.Setenv/t.Chdir, directly or through exposureRepo/newPrePushRepo/useEnvClock. Every assignment to a package var in these files is in a serial test. No parallel test calls a state-swapping helper (runDaemonTicks, newPrePushRepo, realPrePushCheck, useClock, limitFixture, exposureRepo, watchFixture and others), and none uses run temp folders.
